description: TensorFeed's signed trust verdict on one x402 publisher, over its OWN on-chain settlement index: whether a named publisher domain is actively settling, recently quiet, registered with no settlement, unreachable, missing a Base payTo, or not indexed. Requires a domain. tier='preview' is free (10 calls per day per IP), the trust verdict only. tier='full' costs 1 credit ($0.02) and adds the 30-day settlement momentum, the shared-wallet risk flag, the settlement evidence (volume, count, last settled), and an AFTA-signed receipt. Omit tier and you get the free preview, unless the call carries a payment or credits token (or uses the strict x402 transport), in which case it bills as full. Pay per call with an x402 wallet payment (arguments.payment, or an X-PAYMENT header; strict HTTP-402 transport at https://mcp.tensorfeed.ai/mcp?x402=strict) or use an Authorization: Bearer tf_live_... credits token. No token and no USDC? Claim free trial credits by signing a wallet message at https://tensorfeed.ai/api/payment/trial-credits.

domain.description: Publisher domain to rule on, e.g. "x402.tavily.com". Required.

payment.description: Optional base64 x402 payment payload (the same string an X-PAYMENT header would carry). Sign against the accepts[0] requirement returned by an unpaid call. Alternative to the Bearer credits token.

tier.description: 'preview' (free, 10 calls per IP per day) or 'full' (1 credit; adds momentum, shared-wallet flag, evidence, signed receipt). Omitted: preview, unless a payment or credits token is attached.

name: x402_publisher_verdict
